burn.name: Burning
burn.desc: Takes 3 damage per stack each turn; loses 1 stack per turn.

poison.name: Poisoned
poison.desc: Takes 1 damage per stack each turn. Stacks do not fade on their own.

bleed.name: Bleeding
bleed.desc: Takes 2 damage per stack each turn; loses 1 stack per turn.

slow.name: Slowed
slow.desc: Draws one fewer card; enemies deal 15% less.

stealth.name: Stealthed
stealth.desc: +40 evasion. Next attack deals +50% and breaks stealth.

thorns.name: Thorned
thorns.desc: Attackers take damage equal to stacks.

control.name: Controlled
control.desc: Its next action strikes its own ally (or nothing).
